note: If "Batch simulate motors" did nothing when you clicked it, it was disabled rather than broken, and the app never said so. Three states switch it off - the rocket is staged (batch is deliberately not offered across stages, because the motor combinations explode), the rocket has no motor mount, or the design cannot be built - and the tooltip described only the first, so in the other two the button showed its normal description and then did nothing. The reason is now printed under the button where you can see it. Batch simulation across a cluster is unaffected and still works.
